mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing output contraction that reduces corporate profits and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO decline periods, or correlation between INDPRO decline and negative returns p-value > 0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP expansion (GDPC1) above 2% annualized growth signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in <55% of GDPC1 growth >2% cases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) combined with stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 1.0%) signals overheating economy that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases when PAYEMS >0.5% and FEDFUNDS >=1.0%, or interaction term p-value > 0.05 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (housing starts >1.2 million units annually), a decline in housing starts signals potential economic peak, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in >55% of HOUST decline instances during late-cycle, or correlation p-value > 0.05 over 5-year window.
